blocks.label: Overview
bullets: Featuring 1000 mg of Vivomega Triglyceride Fish Oil Concentrate
400 mg EPA and 200 mg DHA per Fish Softgel
paragraphs: Omega-3 fatty acids are a type of good fat that are essential to the body, and they can often be found naturally in foods, especially fish. California Gold Nutrition® Omega-3 Fish Oil contains two types of omega-3s which can help support heart health.*

Benefits of Omega-3 SupplementsA healthy, balanced diet should contain a daily dose of omega-3s, and if you can't get enough from food alone, a daily supplement could be the right solution. An omega-3 supplement can supply an adequate amount of these good fats, which may help provide a number of potentially heart-healthy benefits.* Omega-3s may help you maintain healthy levels of triglycerides and “good” cholesterol, known as HDL.* In addition, it may support healthy blood pressure levels.*

California Gold Nutrition® Omega-3 Fish Oil is formulated with premium fish oil concentrate and features both EPA and DHA in fish gelatin capsules. When taken as directed, this provides approximately a 3-month supply.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Take 1 softgel daily, with food. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Pregnant or lactating women, the chronically ill, elderly, individuals under the age of 18, those taking prescription medications (e.g ., blood thinners) as well as those with a physician-diagnosed medical condition should consult with a physician, pharmacist, naturopath or other qualified healthcare professional prior to taking dietary supplements.
Sealed for your protection. Do not use if seal is missing or broken. Store in a cool, dry place. Protect from heat, light, and moisture.
